|notes=The [[Evacuation Control (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The remaster stacks the top three cards face-up. The period One Rule limits the singular action to once per battle per copy. The remaster also adds a dot to the lower margin. Both the upper title and the underlying Decipher card are unmarked, and the period Virtual card rule inherits the underlying card’s degree of restriction or uniqueness.
